summary.text: INSIGHT REGNSKAP AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2014-01-08. INSIGHT REGNSKAP AS provides accounting services for other companies and financial advisory services, including active participation in other companies. Its statutory purpose also includes other closely related activities. It was previously named SPECTER GHAFFAR AS until 2023-03-17. Its main industry code is 69.202: accounting and bookkeeping. The register shows 6 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 2 957 579 NOK and the annual result was 256 549 NOK; operating income was up from 2 476 033 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 365 047 NOK in 2024 to 256 549 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 371 849 NOK in 2024 to 628 398 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Shaeed Ghaffar (daglig leder) and Abdul Ghaffar (styrets leder). Its verified website is insightregnskap.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram profiles. The registered employee count went from 5 on 2026-04-14 to 6 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
